title: The Mahler Conjecture for General Convex Bodies
main_claim: For every convex body K in R^n, |K||(K-s(K))°| ≥ (n+1)^{n+1}/(n!)^2, with equality exactly for simplices. The proof goes through the Klartag cone/Laplace reduction χ_C(V)χ_D(U) ≥ 1, Moreau-biased Gaussian projection maps, an entropy bound, quadratic Hermite identities, layer-defect control, and a spectral linear-field bound backed by computer-certified scalar inequalities.

issues.description: The documented verification command fails before running anything. reproduce.py reads verification/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json, and that file is not in the release. The saved-original/ comparison directory is also absent. This is a reproducibility and packaging problem, not a mathematical one.
issues.evidence: Running `python3 verification/reproduce.py --output ...` raised FileNotFoundError for SOURCE-MANIFEST.json. With a patched copy of the runner that skips only the hash check, all 10 programs print PASS and RUN.json reports "passed": true.

coverage: I read Sections 1–6 (main proof) in full and the start of Appendix 7. Steps re-derived by hand: the cone-reduction constants (n!|K| and n!m^{-m}|K°|); the Brouwer fixed-point and inward-trace argument; the T-update sandwich via the endpoint inequalities and Löwner–Heinz, and the cancellation λT²+C∘T+K=0; the log-Jacobian identity (F_X', β_X ≥ 0, the ω_z subprobability with mass 1/(4j²)+z/(2j) ≤ π/8+1/2, monotonicity of W_X); γv = log2π−1 and the cost terms ∫W_X a = 1 and C_Y; Prop 11, i.e. C_Y−s_0+Δ_μv = δ[d] and eq (12); the Lemma 13 covariance kernel and the distributional derivative of a(min)B(max); Lemma 16 (all three lines); Lemma 17 (first line in full); the combined profile H and the sign of the contact term in Prop 18; Lemma 19, including the b_m' = 134/309 determinant factorization; Lemma 20 and Lemma 22, including the Cauchy–Schwarz kernels; the 4417/2608 and .78936 constants; Lemma 24; eq (25) with a_R(m*+.341)/2−λ = 1.94875; the J_T/𝔯(C) kernels with the shift invariance and Gram/Young step; the commutator identity H∘[M,T] = [M,K]+T∘[M,C] behind eq (27); and the equality case (commuting M_ℓ, P_z = Θ_z(L), cone is an orthant, K is a simplex). Numerical checks: both integrals (2log2−1 and log2−1/4) and κ²c_g/(8Λ0) = .2448 to 30 digits with mpmath; Lemma 14 with an arbitrary admissible perturbation of r_1 (agrees to about 1e-9); the scalar inequalities of Prop 3 (the first group, (3a) with min margin .024 at z=x=0, (3b) with min ≈ 1.03) on a 1801-point grid on [−9,9]; and segment inequality (4) on all ~1.6M grid segments (strictly positive, smallest margin/ℓ² ≈ 1.3e-4). I also ran all 10 certificate programs, which pass. Not independently checked: the second line of Lemma 17 in full detail, the analytic interpolation and tail arguments in Appendices 7–8 beyond running their programs, and Section 9 (corollaries).
sibling_notes: The family 087 board had no prior entries. The symmetric-Mahler companion paper is cited only for a separate statement and is not used in this proof, so there is no circular dependence. The functional corollary uses Fradelizi–Meyer, Prop 2(a), downstream of the main theorem.
